name: Trouble
overview: Scripture reveals that trouble often arises from fear, dissatisfaction, and testing of God's provision, as seen when the Israelites, pursued by Pharaoh, cried out to the Lord in fear (Exodus 14:10). Their journey through the wilderness was marked by bitter water at Marah and murmuring against Moses and Aaron, expressing regret over their deliverance and doubting God's care (Exodus 15:23, 16:2-3). Their complaints about thirst and hunger highlight human frailty and the challenge of trusting God's timing and provision in difficult circumstances (Exodus 17:2-3). These instances teach believers to rely on God’s faithfulness even amid trials and uncertainty.
